note: Goethe-Zertifikat B1 Wortliste, alphabetical part, letters l to z, only entries that are NOT on the A1 or A2 list (B1 new). Taken from the third-party transcription github.com/ilkermeliksitki/goethe-institute-wordlist (b1/*.tsv), normalized by hand. The transcription itself has page gaps: m (Mann area and the mit- verbs) and s (between schließen and Schnee). Words in those gaps are missing here and must be filled from the official PDF. Pure affixes and fragments (runterwerfen, Tee ziehen lassen, die Zünder) were dropped, and der Pullover is left out here because it is already on A2. ziehen sits here because the A2 transcription does not list it. region is set only where the transcription marks the entry (CH = Swiss, A = Austrian, D = German). month is an editorial assignment for this course, not part of the list. Not yet cross-checked against the official PDF. Wortgruppen not included. Private study use only. | 2026-10-12 괴테 공식 PDF와 대조, 빠진 표제어를 더함(added 칸). 여성형(-in)은 남성형 카드로 함께 다룬다.
